triggers.function_definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.protect_quote_comparison_bid_source()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if old.source_supplier_quote_id is not null
     and row(
       new.source_supplier_quote_id,
       new.source_vendor_name,
       new.source_contact_name,
       new.source_delivery_charge
     ) is distinct from row(
       old.source_supplier_quote_id,
       old.source_vendor_name,
       old.source_contact_name,
       old.source_delivery_charge
     ) then
    raise exception 'quote_comparison_bid_source_provenance_is_immutable';
  end if;
  return new;
end;
$function$

triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER quote_comparisons_manager_push AFTER UPDATE OF client_quote_status ON public.quote_comparisons FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION queue_client_approval_push()
triggers.function_definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.queue_client_approval_push()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if new.client_quote_status in ('accepted', 'approved')
    and new.client_quote_status is distinct from old.client_quote_status then
    perform public.queue_manager_push_event(
      'quote_approval',
      'Client approved a quote',
      coalesce(nullif(new.title, ''), nullif(new.quote_number, ''), 'Open the request for details.'),
      '/admin/quote-comparison/' || new.id::text,
      'quote_approval:' || new.id::text || ':' || new.client_quote_status,
      'avantia-quote-approval-' || new.id::text
    );
  end if;
  return new;
end;
$function$

triggers.function_definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.queue_new_request_push()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if new.status <> 'draft' and (tg_op = 'INSERT' or old.status = 'draft') then
    perform public.queue_manager_push_event(
      'new_order',
      'New material request',
      coalesce(new.title, 'A customer submitted a material request.'),
      '/owner/materials/requests/' || new.id::text,
      'new_order:' || new.id::text,
      'avantia-new-order-' || new.id::text
    );
  end if;
  return new;
end;
$function$

helpers.name: has_staff_capability
helpers.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.has_staff_capability(capability text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1
    from public.profiles profile
    join public.staff_access_grants access
      on access.email = lower(trim(profile.email))
    where profile.id = (select auth.uid())
      and profile.role = 'staff'
      and profile.approval_status = 'approved'
      and profile.is_active = true
      and access.active = true
      and case capability
        when 'customers' then access.can_manage_customers
        when 'suppliers' then access.can_manage_suppliers
        else false
      end
  );
$function$

  );
